neighbours.label: ' see' in wish phrasing ('would like to see', 'want to see') in fan or user commentary
fire: Personally I would love to see the developers add a proper co-op mode next year.
What I really want to see in the next season is more screen time for the villain.
Fans have been asking to see the original soundtrack remastered for years.
I'd like to see them bring the old maps back instead of making new ones.
Most players would rather see fewer microtransactions and more free updates.
Next time I hope to see a longer campaign and fewer loading screens.
Many readers would like to see the author return to the first book's tone.
We would all like to see the studio fix the bugs before adding new features.
